e-ticket noun

also ticket on the phone

* our formation

* (our own formation) tessera in tēlephōnō

a ticket on the phone

chartāceus, chartācea, chartāceum — made of paper (L&S).

Examples

  • omnia nostra sarcinae manuālēs sunt, tesserae in tēlephōnō servantur.

    all our things are hand luggage, and the tickets are kept on the phone.Libellus I, Iter in Lūsitāniam

See also ticket, telephone, hand luggage.
